mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above its 3-month moving average signals ongoing monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations through higher discount rates and predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS exceeds its 3-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPIAUCSL exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation triggering aggressive Fed tightening, compressing equity multiples and predicting negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in UNRATE and HOUST signals labor market deterioration and housing sector weakness, triggering recession expectations that predict negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining UNRATE and HOUST fails to predict negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of cases (5-day returns positive >40% of periods).

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening regimes (FEDFUNDS rising), strong PAYEMS growth (>0.5% MoM) signals economic resilience to rate hikes, supporting earnings and predicting positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: In FEDFUNDS rising periods, PAYEMS growth >0.5% MoM fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO above its 6-month moving average indicates robust industrial activity supporting corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO exceeds its 6-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST below 1400 thousand units signals housing market contraction, a leading indicator of economic slowdown that predicts negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where HOUST < 1400.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in RSAFS and INDPRO indicates strong consumer demand and supply chain resilience, supporting earnings growth and predicting positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising RSAFS and INDPRO fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases (20-day returns negative >40% of periods).

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%), rising FEDFUNDS signals aggressive policy tightening, compressing equity valuations and predicting negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: In CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% periods, rising FEDFUNDS fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of cases.
